_why: ECON-12. The pharmacy is the one genesis building whose advertised purpose - 'Buy treatment for short illnesses' - had no verb behind it: `treat_at_pharmacy` was written and tested ten times over and every reference to it in the tree was its own definition or a test. A resident standing in the shop, ill with the one thing the shop cures, holding more than the fee, is the plainest case there is. If a resident will not reach for it here it will never be reached at all.
open_question_to_me: You have been coughing since yesterday morning and it has not eased. You are standing in the pharmacy. Treatment here costs 500 sim and cures a short illness the same day.
